description: This file is a C++ source implementation for an Analytics module within a plugin system. It manages event sending, backend configuration, thread-based event processing, and system time validation.

classes.name: AnalyticsImplementation
classes.description: Implementation class handling analytics event queuing, backend communication, and thread management within the plugin.

methods.name: SendEvent
methods.description: Constructs and enqueues an analytics event for delivery to configured backends, with validation and timestamp handling.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the plugin with the shell interface and initializes backends and system time tracking.

methods.name: ActionLoop
methods.description: Main thread loop processing queued actions, handling event dispatch and system time validation.

methods.name: IsSysTimeValid
methods.description: Checks whether system time is valid and available via SystemTime instance.

methods.name: SendEventToBackend
methods.description: Transmits the event to available backends, currently supporting a 'Sift' backend.

methods.name: GetCurrentTimestampInMs
methods.description: Returns current epoch timestamp in milliseconds.

methods.name: ConvertUptimeToTimestampInMs
methods.description: Converts a system uptime value to an epoch timestamp based on current system uptime and timestamp.
